column1: # ESP32-S3 N16R8 partition table -- used by the two ESP-NOW envs only.
# WHY A THIRD TABLE: the ESP-NOW images link the whole WiFi stack (net80211 / pp /
#   lwIP / wpa_supplicant) and no longer fit the 1 MB app0/app1 slots that the
#   wired images still use. This table gives the app a single 2 MB factory slot.
# WHAT IS DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED: nvs @0x9000 (so the mute flag survives a reflash)
#   the web editor prints those offsets in its esptool command
#   silently invalidate every flashing instruction in the docs.
